body.statement: In the special case \(q=0\) and \(H=1\), with the corresponding one-date Choi--Yuan subgroup conditions, \(B_2=o(s)\), the third overlap score is absorbed at their pointwise scale, and the standardized leading score and variance reduce to the group central limit theorem and variance formula in Choi and Yuan (2024), Theorem 3.1.
body.justification: The reduction guards against changing the estimand or estimator while enlarging the dependence and target regimes.
body.gap: The published theorem is the reduction target rather than an unresolved result.
body.consumer: Applied users recover the existing one-date procedure when no serial or window correction is needed.

obligation.what_is_open: A source-verified equality with the exact Choi--Yuan one-date theorem and a native curvature estimate proving that the drift is negligible relative to the standard error.
obligation.obstruction: The frozen core contains neither a cited leaf transcribing the published theorem nor a proved native curvature rate. The publication comparison therefore cannot be established solely by the current mathematical primitives.
obligation.attempted: Specialized the full tangent score to zero dependence and one target date and proved that its donor-pre overlap component is negligible at the target standard-error scale.
obligation.partial_result:
At \(q=0\) and \(H=1\), the complete score remains
\[
 \ell_{it}(e)=\sum_{j\in C(t)}a_{ij,t}e_{jt}
 +\sum_{s\in S}b_{t,s}e_{is}
 -\sum_{j\in C(t),s\in S}a_{ij,t}b_{t,s}e_{js}.
\]
The weight calculation above shows that the donor-pre overlap component has squared weight norm \(O(n^{-2})\), whereas variance nondegeneracy gives \(s^2\asymp n^{-1}\); hence that component is \(o_{\mathbb P}(s)\).  Establishing the claimed exact reduction additionally requires a source-verified statement of Choi--Yuan's theorem and a proved native curvature bound implying \(B_2=o(s)\).  Neither premise is present as an established node in the frozen core.
